mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER(TRADER_ID, PARTY_ID, MPARTY_ID, TRADER_NAME, TEL_NO, FAX_NO, MSN, EMAIL, ADDRESS, POST_CODE, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) SELECT A.TRADER_ID, B.PARTY_ID, CASE WHEN C.MPARTY_CUSTOMER_ID IS NULL THEN B.PARTY_ID ELSE D.PARTY_ID END MPARTY_ID, A.TRADER_NAME, A.TEL_NO, A.FAX_NO, A.MSN, A.EMAIL, A.ADDRESS, A.POST_CODE, A.REMARK, A.CREATE_USER, A.CREATE_TIME, A.CREATE_DEPT, A.UPDATE_USER, A.UPDATE_TIME FROM INTERF_CFETS_TRADER_TMP A, INTERF_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TMP B, (SELECT MAX(MPARTY_CUSTOMER_ID) MPARTY_CUSTOMER_ID, SPARTY_CUSTOMER_ID FROM INTERF_CFETS_PARTY_RELA_TMP GROUP BY SPARTY_CUSTOMER_ID) C ,INTERF_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TMP D WHERE A.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID = B.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID(+) AND A.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID = C.SPARTY_CUSTOMER_ID(+) AND C.MPARTY_CUSTOMER_ID = D.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID(+)
